复指数，也有波峰与波谷: The exponential has peaks and valleys
沿虚数方向，指数函数不断起伏；沿实数方向，振幅越来越大。这里的高度是函数值的实部: Along the imaginary direction, the exponential oscillates. Along the real direction, its amplitude grows. Height here shows the real part of the output.
一条正弦，展开成曲面: A sine wave unfolds into a surface
中间的金线是熟悉的正弦曲线。加入虚数输入，两侧的波峰升高、波谷加深：实部等于 s: The gold line is the familiar sine wave. Add an imaginary input, and its peaks rise and valleys deepen on both sides: the real part is sin x × cosh y.
函数值还包含虚部。换一个高度分量，形状就变了；颜色始终表示函数值的方向。: The output also has an imaginary part. Use it as the height, and the shape changes. Color always shows the direction of the output in the complex plane.
靠近原点，数值向两侧增大: Near the origin, values rise and fall
